transcript: People have been asking and asking when are we finally going to get a rush for masquerade, and we are finally getting one. it is going to be an in person lottery and it is for a limited time. But here's everything you need to know. It's called Lotto 6 6 6 and if you win, you'll have the opportunity to buy up to two tickets for sixty six dollars and sixty cents each. It also mentions that special guests from the Phantom of the opera universe will be in attendance, but currently unclear who that will be. The first one will be held on Sunday, November 16th at 5 p. M, although winners will not be pulled until 6 p. M. Now it is currently unclear how often they are going to do this. It doesn't sound like this is going to be daily, but if this is going to be weekly, monthly, random. However, this is not the only cheaper ticket initiative announced. They also announced a black tie standby line for $170. This will be ongoing starting November 12, where any returned or unclaimed tickets will be sold to the standby line. But obviously admittance is not guaranteed, so it's definitely a riskier option. $170 is obviously still a really expensive ticket, but it is now the cheapest ticket they have ever offered outside of this lottery.
